replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Bridges are not good for Frenzy... it'll be a chokepoint.

I also think you need to add some more terrain and remove fences from said terrain, because fences obstruct the walk and they don't level the ground.

Respond back when these issues are fixed.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Your map has been denied for the following reason(s):

- Needs a more appealing block style/variation (aesthetics). Try looking into testing different block variations: what looks good with what and use it to fit into the map's theme. The building at the back uses a basis of 1 block colour, which doesn't look very appealing to the eye, as well as the terrain could use some more improvements.

- Needs more cover/structures towards middle, at the moment its quite easy to get shot

Try adding new concepts to make your map even better that differ from other maps! Consider both the gameplay and aesthetics factors as well, build as you think of a match going on.
Good luck!
